declare a name.description: Name what the body answers, for the steps after it

declare a word.description: Declare a word under the label of its subject, the chain of its function

declare a kind.description: Declare a kind by its page and the chain of its commands

name the subject.description: Name the value in the pipe for the steps after it

set literal.description: Set literal — the vector in the one order without duplicates

groupBy.description: Partition Vec into Map keyed by classifier

indexBy.description: Collapse Vec into Map, last-wins on collision

line plain comment.description: Line comment, which no step reads

block plain comment.description: Block comment, which no step reads

line doc.description: Line doc, the page of the name before it or a value of its own

block doc.description: Block doc, the page of the name before it or a value of its own

sort by key.description: Sort by the key a path reads

union an entry.description: Join to the map in the pipe an entry the template of get computes

minus keys.description: Take the keys of a set off the map in the pipe

inter keys.description: Keep the keys of a set of the map in the pipe
